stem:
Leena has cloudy water with very fine mud after cleaning a courtyard pot. Pouring off the top liquid still leaves the water cloudy.

What should she conclude?

options.text: Filtration through a fine cloth or filter is needed because many particles are too small to settle and pour off cleanly.
A coarse tea strainer alone will catch every mud particle smaller than its holes.
She should switch to a filter with larger pores than the mud particles so the water clears faster.
Filtering salt water through cloth will remove the dissolved salt as a solid on the cloth.

teacher.key_rationale: Fine suspended solids need filtration with pores smaller than the particles. Coarse holes miss fines; larger pores worsen separation; dissolved salt passes through filters.
